newsitem.title: USA: Parlux hires Montgomery to explore options.
newsitem.headline: Parlux hires Montgomery to explore options.

text.p: Parlux Fragrances Inc said on Tuesday it retained the investment firm of Montgomery Securities to explore alternatives to increase shareholder value.
The company said while no decision had been made, management would consider either a sale or merger of Parlux.

Ilia Lekach, chairman and chief executive officer, said: "In contrast to the company's impressive sales growth and earnings performance, we believe the current Wall Street valuation of Parlux is well below standards for global consumer product companies with comparable luxury brand name properties."
He said the board had therefore told management to evaluate alternatives to boost value.
